CONFIG NEVER PERSISTED ON ANDROID. dirs::config_dir() resolves from XDG
vars and $HOME, which a NativeActivity has neither of — so every save
silently wrote nothing. Every launch minted a fresh install identity
(logcat: 'minted install identity name=RCDH' on a phone that was SUDS an
hour earlier), which meant the name grid reopened on EVERY boot, settings
reverted, the room code was forgotten, the career reset, and the rivalry
ledger could never key on a stable install-id. Four modules made the same
wrong guess; only the recorder asked Android where its files go. There is
now one crate::paths helper: internal data path on Android, ~/.config
unchanged on desktop, and the recorder shares it.

THE TITLE WORE THE LAST MATCH. Dropping the ggrs Session stops the sim
dead, so MatchState kept whatever it held when you left — MatchOver, for
any decided match. The summary card keyed on MatchState alone and burned
'STAG WINS 2-5' across the title and the replay list. Worse, the kill-cam
punches in on MatchOver with hold_frames = INFINITY and only releases on
the next Countdown: the camera stayed zoomed 1.6x and parked on the kill
spot, which shrank the anchored UI's view rect until buttons overlapped
and text ran off both screen edges. That is the entire 'UI is messed up'

boot straight to a fresh title and never play a match first. despawn_match
now resets the match resources (state/score/frame/kill-cam/shake); the

perennials/7eeb747:
Replace the 43 hand-authored plants with the entire Permapeople database
(~8,800 species, CC BY-SA 4.0): every plant, description, photo, and attribute
is real, community-sourced data, none authored here.

Architecture is static snapshot plus client-side search. The app fetches one
generated file (public/data/plants.json, ~1.3 MB gzipped), caches it in the
service worker for offline, and filters entirely in memory. Nothing calls a
plant API at runtime: the key can't ship to a browser, and it must work
offline. Results are windowed for smooth scrolling across thousands.

Search is constraint-space: a command bar plus data-derived facets (layer,
light, water, soil, life cycle, growth, edible parts, function, cautions,
family, native range) with live counts, removable chips, and type-ahead for
the large facets. Detail pages show the photo, attribute sheet, description,
warnings, and source links, attributed CC BY-SA to Permapeople.

A weekly workflow re-pulls and re-transforms (credentials as repo secrets) and
commits changes so the snapshot stays current with no runtime dependency.

Removes the old curated model, vocab/filter registry, enrichment pipeline, and
the garden visualizer, which returns on the new model later.
